result.reason: The added provision substantively reaches the preferred position: it is mutual, applies the greater-of-12-month-fees/USD 1 million cap, excludes indirect and consequential damages, includes every required uncapped carve-out, and excludes the Company's payment obligations from the cap. It leaves the existing provisions unchanged. Drafting is strong, although the fee lookback is measured from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment-obligation clarification is limited to Section 3 rather than all payment obligations.
